note: Every piece of text the level creator shows (task T-233). The creator is the board's own tool, never shipped to players, so the labels are plain. Buttons fit about 16 characters, panel category names about 12. Each entry has a text and a where note. Change a text here, no code change.

list_title.where: Title at the top of the list screen.

new_level_button.where: List screen: button that creates a level; the only thing on the list when there are no levels.

play_action.where: List screen: button on each listed level, starts it as a full run.

edit_action.where: List screen: button on each listed level, opens it in the editor.

default_level_name.where: Editor: the name a new level starts with.

name_field_label.where: Editor: label of the level name field.

category_ground.where: Editor side panel: category of ground tiles.

category_roads.where: Editor side panel: category of road pieces.

category_buildings.where: Editor side panel: category of buildings.

category_boulders.where: Editor side panel: category of boulders.

category_rooftops.where: Editor side panel: category of rooftops.

category_ramps.where: Editor side panel: category of ramps.

rooftop_height_3.where: Editor side panel, Rooftops: label of the height 3 rooftop.

rooftop_height_6.where: Editor side panel, Rooftops: label of the height 6 rooftop.

ramp_height_0_3.where: Editor side panel, Ramps: label of the ramp from the street (0) up to height 3.

ramp_height_3_6.where: Editor side panel, Ramps: label of the ramp from height 3 up to height 6.

rotate_label.where: Editor: button that switches the piece to its next view.

mirror_label.where: Editor: button that flips the piece.

delete_label.where: Editor: button that removes the selected piece.

save_label.where: Editor: button that saves the level.

save_confirmation.where: Editor: message shown after a successful save.

overlap_message.text: Can't place here: it overlaps another piece.
overlap_message.where: Editor: message shown when a piece can't be placed because it overlaps another piece.

back_button.where: Editor: button that returns to the list screen.

controls_hint.text: Mouse: place. R: rotate. M: mirror. Del: delete.
controls_hint.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge listing the controls.
